properties.name: vaadin.application-identifier
properties.description: Identifier of the application, used for tracking daily active users per application. By default, it is generated from the build settings of the project.

properties.name: vaadin.brotli
properties.description: Whether precompressed Brotli files are served for static resources when available.

properties.name: vaadin.close-idle-sessions
properties.description: Whether a session is eventually closed when its open UIs have no user interaction. When disabled, heartbeat requests keep the session open as long as there are open UIs.

properties.name: vaadin.com.vaadin.safe-url-schemes
properties.description: Legacy name of vaadin.safe-url-schemes.

properties.name: vaadin.csp
properties.description: Content Security Policy mode of the application.

properties.name: vaadin.devmode.component-tracker.enabled
properties.description: Whether the location in the code where each component is created and attached is tracked in development mode.

properties.name: vaadin.devmode.dev-tools.enabled
properties.description: Whether the development tools are shown in the browser in development mode.

properties.name: vaadin.devmode.live-reload.enabled
properties.description: Whether the browser reloads automatically when the application changes in development mode. Has no effect when the development tools are disabled.

properties.name: vaadin.devmode.output.pattern.timeout
properties.description: Time, in milliseconds, to wait for the frontend development server to report that it has started.

properties.name: vaadin.devmode.session-serialization.enabled
properties.description: Whether the session is serialized in development mode, so it survives a server restart.

properties.name: vaadin.devmode.usage-statistics.enabled
properties.description: Whether anonymous usage statistics are collected in development mode.

properties.name: vaadin.devmode.vite.options
properties.description: Extra command line options passed to Vite in development mode, separated by spaces.

properties.name: vaadin.disable-xsrf-protection
properties.description: Whether the cross-site request forgery protection is disabled. Disabling it is not recommended.

properties.name: vaadin.disable.automatic.servlet.registration
properties.description: Whether Vaadin skips registering the servlets it needs automatically.

properties.name: vaadin.frame-options
properties.description: Value of the X-Frame-Options HTTP response header sent with the application page, for example SAMEORIGIN or DENY. An empty value disables the header, for applications that are meant to be embedded in a frame.

properties.name: vaadin.frontend.hotdeploy.dependencies
properties.description: Comma-separated list of folders of other projects whose frontend files are watched when the frontend development server is used.

properties.name: vaadin.heartbeat-interval
properties.description: Interval, in seconds, between the heartbeat requests of a UI. A non-positive value disables the heartbeat.

properties.name: vaadin.i18n.provider
properties.description: Fully qualified class name of the I18NProvider implementation to use.

properties.name: vaadin.max-message-suspend-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time, in milliseconds, that the client waits for a missing message when messages arrive out of order, before it requests a full resynchronization from the server.

properties.name: vaadin.max-request-body-size
properties.description: Maximum size, in characters, of a client-to-server request body before the request is rejected with HTTP 413. -1 disables the limit. File uploads are not affected.

properties.name: vaadin.menu.access.control
properties.description: Fully qualified class name of the MenuAccessControl implementation to use.

properties.name: vaadin.page-title.generator
properties.description: Fully qualified class name of the PageTitleGenerator implementation to use by default for the whole application.

properties.name: vaadin.push-long-polling-suspend-timeout
properties.description: Time, in milliseconds, that a long polling push request is kept open. -1 means no timeout.

properties.name: vaadin.push-mode
properties.description: Server push mode used by default for the UIs of the application.

properties.name: vaadin.push-servlet-mapping
properties.description: Servlet mapping used for push requests. By default, the mapping of the Vaadin servlet is used.

properties.name: vaadin.request-timing
properties.description: Whether the server sends timing information to the client. Enabled by default in development mode and disabled in production mode.

properties.name: vaadin.reuse-dev-server
properties.description: Whether the frontend development server is reused on each reload in development mode. Set to false in tests so that the server is not kept running after the test.

properties.name: vaadin.safe-url-schemes
properties.description: Comma-separated list of URL schemes that are considered safe in URLs set on components such as Anchor and IFrame. * accepts every scheme. When not set, a built-in list of safe schemes is used.

properties.name: vaadin.send-urls-as-parameters
properties.description: Whether URLs are sent as GET and POST parameters in requests with the content type application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

properties.name: vaadin.session-lock-check-strategy
properties.description: What happens when the session is accessed without holding its lock.

properties.name: vaadin.sync-id-check
properties.description: Whether sync ID checking is enabled. The sync ID lets the server handle a client message to a component that was recently removed on the server.

properties.name: vaadin.themed-html
properties.description: Whether the theme styles plain HTML elements, such as tables, across the whole application.

properties.name: vaadin.web-component-disconnect
properties.description: Time, in seconds, that an embedded web component waits for a reconnect before its server-side component is removed from memory.
